description: GPT-OSS 20B BF16 baseline (8 GPU, EP=8, mock data, iter 6-10 avg)
+Cache get_args() in PrimusTurboGroupedMLP (minor Python overhead reduction)
sink_sliding_window=128 (Triton backend doesn't support sliding window)
PYTORCH_TUNABLEOP_ENABLED=1 (tuning too slow, >30min for first iter)
use_sink_attention=false (aiter v3 native slower than Triton+sink for this workload)
Pre-sort MoE tokens (argsort+index_select replaces fused Triton permute - more memory reads)
